name: QA Gemba Analyzer
description: Log QA rework events to a shared workbook and chart YTD / last-week performance for Gemba meetings (printable PDF).
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the 'ASA Quality Management System' library so the shared Gemba rework log is reachable (each QA laptop needs it synced).
No setup data is needed - the first run creates an empty log if none exists.
how_it_works: Click 'Log Rework' to add a rework event (batch, part, material, recut, missing material, failure mode).
The dashboard charts the log - pie, column, and stacked - with time-window, group-by, and threshold toggles, and refreshes as new entries land.
'Open Rework Log' opens the shared workbook in Excel for hand edits.
output: One row appended per rework event in the shared log, a live Gemba dashboard, and a one-click 'Gemba Pack' PDF for the meeting.

fields.label: Shared data folder
fields.description: Folder that holds the shared QA rework log workbook. Leave blank to use the Gemba folder in the ASA Quality Management System library (Quality Assurance\South Portland\CI & Metrics\Gemba - synced to every laptop that syncs that library).
